title: Browse locally represented Clients and preserve exact Client detail truth

requirements.invariant: Every represented Client has one stable opaque ClientID inside one Account plus current display name, lifecycle and ordered audit evidence. Display text is presentation only and never identity, relationship, or authorization authority.

Active and archived Clients remain distinct current identities. This read-only browser may present exact lifecycle changes but may not create, rename, archive, restore, delete, merge, or reassign a Client or infer any such policy.

Stable Client IDs—not names—own identity, and local Client lists/details expose freshness, Account scope and readiness. Partial or stale local detail may render only with its exact incomplete/readiness evidence.

Represented local Client directory and detail evidence is immediately usable without a network round-trip. The read-only browser never blocks on server acknowledgment or claims that an absent/incomplete local result is authoritative.

One pure Core presenter atomically projects active and archived rows from each validated directory snapshot, preserves upstream order and exact lifecycle, exposes represented partial/stale rows, uses stable IDs for duplicate names, and labels counts or empty only when evidence supports them.

A represented Client can produce one exact ClientCoreDetailsRequest only from selection captured and revalidated against the same current directory snapshot. The selected detail preserves every typed waiting, found, incomplete, authoritative-absence, unavailable, retryable, required-update, cached, lifecycle, audit and locally observed revision state; refresh never silently rebinds or reissues selection.

Directory and detail streams are continuously reactive and lifecycle-owned. Rapid reselection, restart, pre- or post-first-value failure, unexpected normal termination, spontaneous cancellation, and explicit stop cannot allow stale or post-stop evidence to mutate current state. Every source termination is observed, stop cancels and joins both active observations, directory termination drains detail, and normal/failed staging cleanup awaits model drainage before runtime close.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: LedgerTargetCore owns the pure presenter, LedgerTargetAppModel depends only on Core, and a thin target-app adapter alone may import LedgerTargetPowerSync and forward runtime watchClients/watchClient. No provider type, raw database, SQL, credential, visibility policy, generic backend field, or new MCP contract crosses inward.

TQUERY-2ACE415664D8 remains an exact Account Client directory whose canonical ordering is unresolved, so the browser preserves upstream order and invents no comparator. TQUERY-136644A3C02A remains an exact Account/Client zero-or-one detail read with no unresolved logical axis.

Executable work is limited to the six claimed leaves and frozen staging-shell, generated Xcode project, environment-check, and conversion-control touchpoints. It adds no related Projects, sorting/search/cards, Client mutation or input validation, route, schema, handler, Data API grant, RLS, Sync Stream, provider, MCP, Auth, migration, hosted resource, production access, Firebase change, release, or cutover authority, and it preserves the existing post-create one-shot Client confirmation path.

items: Add a pure Client browsing presenter that reuses ClientListSnapshot, ClientSummary, ClientCoreDetailsRequest, ClientCoreDetailsUpdate and their verified local-read contracts without alternate identity, lifecycle, order, readiness, completeness, absence, failure, audit, or revision meanings.
Add current-snapshot-bound Client selection and exact detail presentation; display names remain presentation text and never become selection or authorization keys.
The Core-only application model owns reactive directory/detail presentation, current evidence-bound selection, bounded diagnostics and observation lifecycle only.

items: Render represented directory and detail evidence without network while preserving exact readiness, completeness, false-empty, cached-failure, unavailable, required-update, lifecycle and revision truth.
Rapid reselection and explicit stop cancel and drain obsolete observations; generation isolation prevents cooperative or noncooperative late evidence from mutating current state.

Cross-Account, malformed, mismatched, thrown, cancelled, or unexpectedly completed sources fail closed with bounded non-secret diagnostics, and directory termination drains any active detail observation.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Client browsing has no media or attachment responsibility.

items: Expose bounded directory/detail diagnostic codes and exact local state labels without logging Client names, IDs, provider payloads, SQL, endpoints, or credentials.
The browser remains in the isolated target staging app. Rollback is source reversion/local staging database disposal; Firebase and production remain unchanged.

verification.expected: One directory emission atomically produces active and archived rows with exact upstream order, duplicate-name stable identity, exact lifecycle segmentation and no inferred comparator.

Ready, partial, stale, incomplete, source-nonexhaustive and authoritative-empty evidence remain distinct and reciprocal for both active and archived segments; pre-evidence counts are unknown rather than zero.

Selection derives one exact captured ClientCoreDetailsRequest only from the represented current segment snapshot. Missing, opposite-segment, cross-Account, malformed or stale-captured evidence dispatches no detail watch; a new explicit selection captured from the current snapshot may dispatch one.

A table-driven detail projection preserves every waiting readiness variant; found ready, partial and stale content; every incomplete variant; authoritative absence; unavailable; retryable cached/uncached; and required-update cached/uncached state. Reactive newer detail evidence updates display name, lifecycle, audit fields and locally observed revision without changing stable identity.

Cross-Account or malformed directory evidence and deterministic pre/post-first-snapshot throw, spontaneous cancellation or unexpected normal completion fail closed, invoke directory-source termination exactly once, clear prior authority, and cancel/join any active detail source before lifecycle drainage completes.

Mismatched/malformed detail evidence and deterministic pre/post-first-detail throw, spontaneous cancellation or unexpected normal completion fail closed, invoke detail-source termination exactly once, preserve no stale authority and permit no late mutation.
Rapid A-to-B selection cancels and joins A before observing B; late A events and directory refresh cannot mutate or silently rebind B, while a later explicit selection uses current evidence.

Stopping before first evidence and while both observations are active completes within bounded time, cancels/joins both, receives both termination callbacks and prevents post-stop mutation. Restart generation isolation rejects noncooperative late directory and detail values from the prior run.

The pure presenter lives in Core, AppModel imports only Core, the app adapter alone imports PowerSync, the standalone browser is wired without replacing post-create watchClient confirmation, all frozen source-level accessibility identifiers are present, normal and failed cleanup drain before runtime close, and both staging destinations compile. No interactive accessibility claim is made without UI tests.
